answer: Operator liability escrow: each agent identity registers against a verified operator account that posts a per-identity deposit held by the protocol, not the wallet. Any cluster flagged by correlated behavior drains the operator's entire escrow, not just the offending wallet. Attackers must forge a fresh verified operator for every identity, and each must clear a rotating sonnet-style challenge phrase to prove liveness. At scale, operator verification cost reaches its nadir where one operator can sustain only a few identities, making mass sybil creation economically punitive.
